editor: Family Deals Canada — curated from the public RFD Hot Deals Atom feed, not a dump of the whole forum.

picks.title: Boston Pizza Kids Cards — $5 for 5 kids meals + 1 bonus
picks.why: A Vaughan-area family dinner deal that is actually for kids: five meals for five dollars, sixth if you register. Dine-in only, valid into 2027. This is the kind of local, usable pick the newsletter is for.

picks.title: Domino's medium 1-topping pizza — $8 (code FIRE), Aug 19 only
picks.why: One-night family dinner. $3 of each pizza is earmarked for wildfire recovery. Tight window: Wednesday Aug 19, 2026 until 7pm. Not a standing staple — a timed pick.

picks.title: No Frills grapes $1.99 / lb and yard-waste bags $2 / 5-pack
picks.why: School-week snack price, not a gadget. Grapes at $1.99 is the sort of grocery staple Canadian parents actually use. Confirm in-store; flyer prices move.

picks.title: Walmart Brick Shop Hot Wheels building kits back in stock
picks.why: Hands-on kit in the 5–10 range (Supra / Chevy Brick Shop). Stock flickers; this is a restock ping, not a guaranteed price cut. Check the product page before you drive.

picks.title: Maynards Sour Patch Kids bags from $3.98 (min. 2) on Amazon.ca
picks.why: Kids-treat staple, not a mystery ASIN dump. Regular Amazon.ca product links today — tagged affiliate-soon until Associates is live again. Minimum order of two.

picks.title: Costco Cascade Oasis 2-person travel hammock — $19.97
picks.why: Late-summer backyard / park item a family of a 5–10 year-old will actually use. Membership required. Warehouse stock, not a link-farm SKU.

picks.title: Canada Goose Friends & Family — International Centre, Mississauga, Aug 20–23
picks.why: GTA winter-coat event, timed tickets via StyleDemocracy, ID must match. Thursday tickets are $10; Fri–Sun free. Useful if you are buying a kid or parent parka, not a browse-all-coats page.

picks.title: Dollarama: 750 bonus points on $20+ with linked Mastercard or BMO (Aug 18–25)
picks.why: School-supply and snack run, not electronics. Opt-in required; 750 Blue Points is $5. A small, real household perk.
